name: HOZO claims group-to-form publishing and chooser
type: HOZO claims administration and LINE entry routing
requiresDatabases: Existing AM Platform PostgreSQL claims authority database
requiresEnv: Existing HZ2_CLAIMS_LIFF_ID and Finance Claims V3 bridge configuration
dependencies: AM-IMP-2026.0912.01 Finance V3 self-service claims authority backend

dataIsolation.guard: Assignments use tenant-scoped opaque group lookups; selector sessions use opaque lookups and authenticated ciphertext already governed by forced RLS.

definitionOfDone: Each of four forms can be immediately published to an exact set of active LINE groups
Unconfigured groups preserve their current direct V3 behavior for safe canary rollout
Configured groups receive an applicant-bound short-lived chooser before any form opens
Legacy forms are locked to the selected mode and V3 remains server-revalidated
Zero-form, revoked member, changed assignment, expired link and cross-user access fail closed
Synthetic checks, package validation and production verification pass
